role: Graduate civil engineer or civil design support - expression of interest (Clayton)
subject: Graduate civil engineer EOI, Clayton, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to a named vacancy. Your careers page says you have no open positions right now and invites future opportunity CVs to info@dtmgeocivil.com.au, so I am writing about graduate civil engineering or civil design support with your Clayton team.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as project in charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office and site work across Melbourne. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so mentoring on pavement and civil design support is what I am looking for.

DTM Geocivil focuses on geotechnical investigation, pavement and hardstand design, testing and civil engineering services for Melbourne clients.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: This is a speculative enquiry. Your careers page states there are no open positions and invites future opportunity CVs to info@dtmgeocivil.com.au. I am interested in graduate civil engineering or civil design support with your Clayton team on pavement, hardstand and related civil work.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project in charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with inspections, procurement tracking and progress reports.

I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. Clayton is a workable Melbourne commute for me. I have not yet held an Australian consulting role, and commercial geotech testing would be new learning under your team.
I have attached my resume. I would like to support pavement and civil design work for your clients when a junior opening arises. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
